title: acinos arvensis subsp. eglandulosus
intro: Acinos arvensis subsp. eglandulosus, commonly known as Thyme Thyme, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has identified various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antioxidant, antispasmodic, and expectorant activities, which may help alleviate respiratory issues and soothe digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Acinos arvensis subsp. eglandulosus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
